posts.name: Rajesh Shirsagar
posts.cooked:
Hello @Avinash,

Thanks for pointing this out. From what you’ve described, it seems like the system is incorrectly calculating total taxable income under the India Old Regime when only the “Allow Tax Exemption Declaration” checkbox is selected, especially in cases where the employee declaration is not submitted.

This could be due to the system still considering exemptions without any actual declared amounts, which should ideally not happen.

To help the community and maintainers reproduce and fix this issue, could you please provide:

  • ERPNext version you are using
  • A sample salary structure or employee tax slab setup (if possible)
  • Any logs or screenshots showing the mismatch

You may also want to raise a GitHub issue if not already done, so the core team can track it officially: GitHub · Where software is built

Hope this gets resolved soon. Appreciate you reporting it!

Best,
invokker(Rajesh S.)
